critical_code_review_comments: TimeTrackerWidget: `const today = isoDate()` is recomputed each render but is a primitive string, so useCallback([today]) stays referentially stable -> no loop. Caveat: if the tab stays open past midnight the string changes and the widget silently re-fetches for the new day, which is actually desirable but undocumented.
OreLavoro: firstDay/lastDay are useMemo'd on [year, month], so refresh identity changes only on month/year change - verified empirically (exactly 1 extra fetch per change).
Both refresh callbacks have no state dependency inside, so the useEffect(refresh) pattern is safe. No further action needed.

Pre-existing (not caused by this fix, carried over from iter20): POST /api/time-entries still lacks employee_id+date uniqueness and ISO format validation; OreLavoro.jsx is ~580 lines with an inline <style> block.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The eslint deps fix is verified safe: no refresh loop in TimeTrackerWidget or OreLavoro. Note that dev mode doubles every mount fetch because of React.StrictMode - expect 2 GETs at mount and treat >2 as a loop. CI=true yarn build is clean, so the Vercel build failure is resolved. Nothing outstanding from iter21; remaining open items are the pre-existing backend validation gaps listed in iteration_20.json (time-entry uniqueness/format validation, daily_hours > 0) and the mobile long-scroll cosmetic note.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the Vercel failure was CRA treating react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings as errors when CI=true; refresh() was declared inline and omitted from the useEffect deps. Wrapping refresh in useCallback with primitive/memoised deps (today; firstDay/lastDay) both satisfies the lint rule and keeps the callback identity stable, so the mount effect runs once per logical dependency change - confirmed by network-call counting in Playwright.
